setName: Yu-Gi-Oh! GX Tag Force 2 promotional cards

Super Rare.name: Chaos Burst
Super Rare.desc: When your opponent's monster declares an attack: Tribute 1 monster, then target the attacking monster; destroy that target, then inflict 1000 damage to your opponent.

Super Rare.name: Dark Bribe
Super Rare.desc: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card: Your opponent draws 1 card, also negate the Spell/Trap activation, and if you do, destroy it.

Super Rare.name: Mad Reloader
Super Rare.desc: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Send 2 cards from your hand to the GY, and if you do, draw 2 cards.
